consumer: The NPC dialogue gate's u_has_items condition lambda in condition.cpp::set_has_items, asking 'does the alpha character actor have id_card on their person?' to decide if the door opens.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded weapon + worn + personal inventory), NOT nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items (u_has_items) — builds the dialogue condition lambda that returns actor->has_charges(id,count)||actor->has_amount(id,count) over the character actor, whose item set per visitable.cpp::visit_items is wielded+worn+inv (on-person reach).
divergence: An id_card lying on the tile adjacent to the player (within crafting_inventory() reach) but not worn/wielded/carried: a crafting_inventory-scoped answer (mission.cpp::is_complete) returns YES and wrongly opens the door, while the correct on-person check returns NO.
